people.imagined: The far end of the ice at dawn. She has been sitting so long that two sparrows have landed on her knees; the viewer must say her name three times. She is nearing the eighth layer and keeps what she suspects.
people.subject: The moment: at the far end of the frozen river at dawn she sits so still that two small brown sparrows have settled on her folded knees, and her eyes are only just opening. Face: a pale, still, oval face of about thirty-two with frost-white lashes, calm half-lidded grey eyes, smooth straight brows, a small nose and a closed, peaceful mouth, a faint blue-white rime glittering on her cheeks. Hair: black, in a plain low knot under a wide straw hat tied with a blue cord, a single icicle-shaped silver pin through the knot. Clothing: three layers of indigo-grey silk with crossed collars edged in frost-white, the inner collar embroidered with frozen ripples; wide sleeves spread on the ice in soft folds; over the shoulders a straw-gold rain cape woven fine as silk; a pale silk sash with a small white jade toggle. Hands and objects: her open hands rest on her knees beside the sparrows, one of which looks straight at the viewer; at her feet a round dark ice hole with a river-silk line sunk in it. Power: a thin drift of blue-white qi like breath-mist curls up from her shoulders, a few motes of frost glittering in the air. Background: a vast white frozen river under drifting mist, a faint pink sunrise. Light: cold pearl-pink and blue spirit-light from the upper left, a soft silver rim light along the hat and shoulders. Expression: patient, still, withdrawn.

people.imagined: The harbour at the escort's start, a hundred oars. He bellows across the ice-edge for the boats to line up, and his big flat hands rest on his hips. He wants the Keeper to be his old friend.
people.subject: The moment: standing on the bow of a boat at the harbour mouth he cups one huge hand round his mouth and bellows at the fleet behind the viewer. Face: a broad, flat, red-brown face of about forty-five, thick dark brows drawn together, small bright honest eyes, a wide nose broken once, a thick black beard flecked with frost, the mouth wide open, cheeks flushed raw with cold. Hair: thick black, tied at the nape with a silk cord and a plain silver pin, a wide straw hat pushed back. Body: huge, barrel-chested, planted wide, his big flat scarred whaler's hands in the foreground, one cupped at the mouth, the other spread on his hip. Clothing: layered indigo-grey silk robes, the crossed collars edged in frost-white and left open at the throat, the wide sleeves tied back above the elbow with blue cord; a straw-gold rain cape over the shoulders; a brocade sash with a silver harpoon-head pendant hung from it; high dark boots. Hands and objects: a long oar held under one arm; at his feet a coil of rope and a boat hook against the gunwale. Power: a visible haze of blue-white qi rises off his shoulders with his steaming breath, glittering ice motes caught in it. Background: a grey harbour of broken ice floes, a row of boats with oars lifted, pale silver mist. Light: bright cold spirit-light from the upper left with a soft blue rim along the beard. Expression: brows knotted and jaw thrust forward, eyes bright and frank, the whole broad face shouting.

people.imagined: The fish landing. He counts the ice-fish on his fingers with his lips moving, earnest and chubby; he has begun to learn the abacus and doesn't know why.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a pile of silver fish on a quay at dusk he counts them on his fingers, lips moving silently. Face: a round, chubby, earnest face of about twenty with pink cheeks, wide serious brown eyes, short thin brows, a small nose and full pursed lips, his left hand raised large in the frame with fingers bent one by one. Hair: dark brown, short and combed flat under a small straw hat tied with a blue cord. Body: round, soft and short, shoulders sloped, his round tummy pressing against the robe's frost-white toggles, knees bent in a wide squat. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a short-sleeved indigo-grey silk jacket over a pale inner robe, a single crossed collar with a thin line of embroidered ripples; a small straw-gold rain cape; a woven silk belt with a tally cord and a small jade bead. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a slim split-reed tally stick with five small notches; four silver fish lie lined up on the wet planks by his knee. Background: frosted silver fish on dark planks, the shapes of boats, grey sky fading to deep blue mist. Light: soft cool moonlit glow from the upper left, pale light running along the wet scales and giving his cheeks a cold pink flush. Expression: eager, round-eyed, trusting and content, lips moving over the count. A faint cool blue sparkle of water qi near the fish, no aura.

people.imagined: The Liên Giang fish stall. She guts a fish with a quick wrist, listening hard to a servant of the Liễu house chatting, a hand ready for the forgotten change.
people.subject: The moment: at the Liên Giang fish stall she slits open a silver fish with a quick wrist, her head turned sharp toward someone speaking off frame. Face: a broad, bright, brown face of about twenty-two with wide cheeks, quick sharp black eyes, arched brows and a wide mouth in a canny half-smile; one silver scale stuck to her cheek and a fleck of dark slime on her lower lip. Hair: black, tied up in a clean pale-blue silk scarf with a loose curl, a small silver pin. Body: sturdy, broad, quick. Clothing: a neat indigo-grey silk blouse with a crossed collar edged in frost-white, the wide sleeves tied up above the elbow with blue cord; a pale straw-gold rain cape slung on her back; a silk sash with a small knife in a jade-capped sheath and a cloth purse hidden in the sleeve; both forearms bare, glittering with silver and rainbow fish scales, in the foreground. Hands and objects: a broad gutting knife in the right hand, a fish in the left. Background: a wooden stall with hanging dried fish under a pale blue awning, a blurred crowd, a gull on a post, baskets of ice with silver fish. Light: cold moonlit spirit-glow from the upper left, the scales on her arms catching it like tiny mirrors. Expression: canny, gregarious, one ear cocked, ready for the forgotten change. A faint blue sparkle of water qi round the fish.

people.imagined: At his ice hole on a winter morning. A girl passes behind him and he goes red to the ears, his long reed-cutter's arms folded in tight. He was told to watch how she sits and he watches nothing else.
people.subject: The moment: seated at his ice hole on a winter morning he looks sideways over his shoulder at someone passing behind him, his ears burning red. Face: a long, thin, brown face of about twenty-nine with a wide jaw, large soft brown eyes, faint brows, a long nose and a half-open, helpless mouth; both ears and cheeks bright crimson against the white frost, the pale light shining through the reddened ears. Hair: brown, long and unkempt with a few reed-flower fluffs caught in it, under a tilted straw hat tied with a blue cord. Body: tall, gangly, very long arms and large hands folded awkwardly across his drawn-up knees, as if he had too many limbs to arrange. Clothing: indigo-grey silk robes with crossed collars embroidered with frozen ripples, the sleeves a little short for his arms; a long straw-gold rain cape; a blue silk cord at the neck, a pale jade bead at his belt. Hands and objects: beside him an ice hole with a line running to a short reed rod propped in the snow, a second neatly cut empty hole a pace away, and a reed whistle on a cord. Background: white ice, mist, a faint dark figure walking away. Light: cool pearl-pink spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a shy, sidelong, humble, helpless half-smile. A thin blue-white glimmer of water qi on the ice, no aura.

people.imagined: The boat, after the third watch. He rows and then folds his hands when not rowing, as the Pavilion taught, and his split lips never smile. He held a weaker boy's face to the ice for the lesson.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a boat after the third watch he rests with his hands folded exactly one over the other, looking coolly at the viewer. Face: a narrow, pale, severe face of about twenty-one with a long jaw, cold calm light-grey eyes, thin straight brows, a thin nose and a flat thin mouth; both lips cracked with dark red splits and rust-brown crust at the corners, tiny frost crystals on his lashes. Hair: black, tied back in a tight tail under a straw hat whose brim shadows his eyes. Body: tall, straight, tidy, shoulders level, his spine not touching the boat's rib, knees together as if on a bench in a hall. Clothing: a clean indigo-grey silk robe with a high crossed collar, evenly stitched and neatly fastened with polished white horn toggles, a pale straw-gold cape set exactly square; a plain silk sash. Hands and objects: the two pale folded hands raw red along the palm edges, at the bottom of the frame; the long oar leaning against the thwart with its grip dark with old stains. Background: a grey river fading into mist, the oar laid across the boat. Light: cold grey-blue moonlight from the upper left, a thin pale line of light along the oar and his cracked lips, the eyes in shadow. Expression: a cool, patient, flat calm with a cruelty that never reaches the pale eyes. A faint blue-white chill of water qi in the air around his hands.

people.imagined: First freeze. She has cut the holes and keeps the tally of the dead's holes; the knotted hemp cord on her wrist is as thick as a bracelet. She wants to know why the old sitters cut theirs in pairs.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling on new ice at first freeze she looks up from a half-cut hole, one wrist raised, her breath making short clouds. Face: a young, stern, round face of about eighteen with windburnt pink cheeks, steady dark brown eyes, thick straight brows, a small nose and a firm closed mouth; a reverent, questioning shadow in the eyes. Hair: black, in two braids wound up under a straw hat tied with blue cord. Body: short, strong, knees planted in the snow, back bowed over the work. Clothing: a short-sleeved indigo-grey silk jacket over a pale under-robe with a crossed collar embroidered with tiny frozen ripples, quilted at the sleeves; a straw-gold rain cape pushed back; a blue silk cord at the neck; pale silk leggings bound with ribbons. Hands and objects: a long iron ice chisel in her right hand; round the left wrist, wound many times like a heavy bracelet, a thick cord of knotted hemp with dozens of knots, large and clear. Ice chips ring the hole, and behind her a line of finished holes recedes in pairs, each with a knotted cord tied to a peg. Background: a half-cut round hole in white ice, pale mist, a dark blue dusk sky. Light: pale moonlit spirit-light from the upper left; frost scatters tiny blue sparkles over her hands and the wrist cord. Expression: stubborn and brave, brows drawn down, lips set. A faint blue mote or two of water qi drifting over the ice, no aura.

people.imagined: The head at his ice hole in winter. He speaks as if each word cost a fish. The hook has been dropped through the ice every winter since 1120. The seat of his robe is worn through and he will not mend it.
people.subject: The moment: seated at his ice hole he holds a fine line between finger and thumb and looks silently at the viewer. Face: a long, thin, grey face of about fifty-six with hollow cheeks, deep-set patient pale eyes, long grey brows rimed with frost, a long nose and a thin closed mouth; a long thin grey beard hung to the chest, every hair furred white with ice crystals, frost lying in the hollows of his cheeks and on his lashes. Hair: grey, in a topknot held by a long silver icicle-shaped hairpin under a wide straw hat with a blue cord. Body: thin, stooped, narrow. Clothing: the head's richest version of the sect dress: a frost-white gauze over-robe drifting over a thick indigo-grey silk robe with three crossed collars embroidered with frozen ripples, silver icicle-pendant tassels on the sash; the seat of the robe worn through and left unmended on purpose, a sworn habit and the one flaw he keeps, the rest clean and sound; a long frost-white straw cape of fine silk-straw. Hands and objects: a bone-white fishhook on a river-silk line running down into the hole at his feet. Power: a still pale-blue aura of frost-qi lies around him like a second mantle, fine ice motes hanging in the air, a ring of new ice spreading round the hole. Background: a vast white river under a low grey sky, a faint line of hills, mist drifting low, a black raven far off on the ice. Light: cold silver spirit-light from the upper left with a soft white rim. Expression: a hushed, unmoving face, lips pressed shut, the pale eyes fixed on the line as if at an altar.

people.imagined: The grand elder on the ice, so still that he looks like a heap of snow. A frost-white cape of three hundred winters; he lifts his head and the snow seems to speak.
people.subject: The moment: a tiny figure so covered in a white straw cape that he resembles a heap of snow, slowly lifting his face out of it. Face: a tiny, ancient, nut-brown face as wrinkled as dried fruit, bright small black eyes, long white eyebrows, a tiny nose, a toothless, calm, kind smile and a few white whiskers each whitened with frost. Hair: white, wispy, escaping from a wide straw hat shaped like a bowl, tied with a cord, a thin silver icicle pin. Body: tiny, huddled, round as a boulder. Clothing: the richest and oldest of the sect's dress: a huge cape of straw woven fine as silk and gone white with frost, shaped like a conical haystack, its straw furred with ice, covering him to the ground and filling most of the frame; beneath it, glimpsed at the neck, layered frost-white gauze and indigo-grey silk with three crossed collars and silver ripple embroidery, a pendant of white jade. Hands and objects: one small wrinkled brown hand emerging with an old gourd cracked at the lip, its cord worn smooth; in the other, a black river pebble. Power: the greatest aura in the sect: a vast, calm, pale-blue-white glow of water-and-ice qi surrounds the cape like a halo, snowflake motes drifting upward as if the snow itself were breathing, the ice around him faintly luminous. Background: a flat white ice field and pale sky, nothing else. Light: soft white spirit-light from the upper left, a silver rim around the cape. Expression: eyes bright and crinkled, the toothless mouth softly curved, a face at ease with the cold and with the viewer.

people.imagined: The boat yard on a bright marsh morning. She is married to the head and runs everything that does not involve sitting still; the reed-flower pins in her hair are white as summer snow.
people.subject: The moment: striding along a boat-yard quay on a bright marsh morning with orders on her tongue, she half turns, one hand sweeping out to point. Face: a round, brisk, brown face of about forty-two with bright cheeks, quick shrewd dark eyes, arched brows, a snub nose and a wide smiling mouth, chin lifted. Hair: black, in a high round coil crowned with a half-dozen white feathery reed-flower sprays and silver pins, a second pair of sprays tucked behind her left ear. Body: sturdy, short, quick, shoulders broad, her stride long for her height. Clothing: a steward's richer version of the sect dress: indigo-grey silk jacket with three crossed collars embroidered with frozen ripples and bright blue cord trim, a frost-white gauze over-sash, a straw-gold rain cape short on the shoulders, a long pleated skirt; sleeves pushed up; at her silk belt a small brass abacus of twelve rows of brown wooden beads swinging, with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: a rolled blank paper in her left hand, the right hand pointing. Power: a faint pale-blue shimmer of water qi at her sleeves and a few drifting motes, modest and bright. Background: a boat-yard with hulls on trestles, white reed flowers in a misty marsh beyond. Light: bright clear spirit-light from the upper left, the white flowers in her hair taking a rim light almost like a halo of snow. Expression: pragmatic, genial, shrewd.

people.imagined: Dawn at Tuyết Đăng Trấn harbour. The skin of ice over the water; he breaks it with his elbow, red-faced and laughing, because he is the one who cannot sit still.
people.subject: The moment: on a harbour quay at dawn he swings his bent right elbow down through a skin of ice with a roar. Face: a loud, broad, brick-red face of about forty-eight, small merry bloodshot blue eyes, thick sandy brows whitened with frost, a wide nose, a gap-toothed grin and a stubbly sandy beard tipped with frost; shouting. Hair: sandy, thick and untidy, a silk band round the forehead with a silver clasp, a few strands steaming in the cold. Body: big, bull-necked, restless, barrel chest heaving, steam rolling from his mouth, heavy shoulders rounded forward. Clothing: a heavy indigo-grey silk robe in the sect's colours worn open at the throat over layered pale collars, the sleeves cut short at the elbow; a straw-gold cape thrown back; a brocade sash with a jade pendant and a curved cutlass in a plain scabbard. Hands and objects: the bent elbow in the foreground wrapped in a wet cloth strip, shards of ice flying; the other hand holds a boat hook with a rusted iron tip and rope loop. Power: a roiling pale-blue aura of water qi bursts off the elbow with the blow, bright motes of ice scattering, stronger than any junior's. Background: a misty harbour, grey ice, black masts, pale pink dawn. Light: pink-gold dawn spirit-light from the upper left catching each flying shard as a small bright spark. Expression: a loud, bold, red-faced roar of glee.

people.imagined: The stall in the market. He grins to show the gold tooth he's proud of while his stained thumb presses on the scale; he counts every scale of the tax twice.
people.subject: The moment: behind a fish stall he grins broadly with one thumb pressed on the pan of a hanging scale. Face: a round, sly, ruddy face of about thirty-six with small bright black eyes, thin eyebrows, a round nose and a trimmed moustache; a single upper front tooth capped in bright gold shining in his wide grin. Hair: black, oiled, in a small knot under a dark silk cap with a silver pin. Body: stocky, middling height, leaning forward over the counter on both forearms, his round stomach pressed against the plank edge. Clothing: a merchant's well-cut indigo-grey silk coat with crossed collars embroidered with silver ripples, clean; a short straw-gold cape thrown on the back; a silk sash with a jade abacus charm; the thumb stained pale with fish scales. Hands and objects: the scale with a single silver ice-fish curled in the pan, its beam tilted slightly toward his side; a small abacus with black beads on the counter. Background: a market stall, hanging dried fish, a pale blue cloth awning tinting everything cool. Light: bright cold spirit-light from the upper left, a bright spot of reflected light on the gold tooth. Expression: greedy, hearty, canny. A faint blue sparkle of water qi round the fish, no aura.

people.imagined: On the ice at night, the way her grandmother taught her brother. In the morning she will show her teacher a wrong posture on purpose; her half-smile hides it.
people.subject: The moment: seated at her hole on the ice at night she turns a half-smile on someone standing over her, her back deliberately slumped. Face: a thin, pale, finely made face of about twenty-eight with a distinctly narrow pointed chin, clever light-grey hooded eyes, thin neat brows, a small straight nose and a small half-smile lifting only one corner. Hair: black, in a loose knot under a wide straw hat in the old river style, a thread of pale blue ribbon and a single white reed-flower tucked into the hat cord, a silver pin. Body: slender, sitting in a deliberately imperfect posture, shoulders rounded forward and chin tucked, an obvious fault. Clothing: an inner disciple's fine indigo-grey silk robe with crossed collars, well fitted, blue cord edging, embroidered frozen ripples on the collars; a straw-gold rain cape set on one shoulder; pale silk gloves; a silk sash with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: both hands tucked into her wide sleeves; beside her a frozen hole, perfectly round with a thin rim of new ice, a line in it. Power: a faint pale-blue shimmer of water qi along the ice-rim, motes small and few. Background: a night ice field, faint stars, a tiny warm lantern glow far across the ice. Light: cold moonlight from the upper left with a silver rim light. Expression: a mild, careful half-smile with lowered lids and watchful eyes that hide the lie, loyal in manner, sly at the corners of the mouth.

people.imagined: The afternoon watch. He ships his oar and lets another man pull both sides, grinning in the sun-slackened way of someone who believes it will all come out. His shoulders are an oarsman's.
people.subject: The moment: slouched in a boat on the afternoon watch with his oar shipped across his knees and his hands behind his head, grinning lazily. Face: a broad, sun-browned, handsome face of about twenty-two with half-closed sleepy brown eyes, thick brows, a short nose and a wide slack easy smile. Hair: black, tousled, a straw hat tipped over one eye. Body: broad-shouldered, lazy, sprawled, the oarsman's shoulders enormously broad and thickly muscled; chest bare and deeply tanned under the open vest, a faint sunburn line at the collarbone. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: an indigo-grey silk vest with frost-white toggles worn open over the bare chest, short sleeves, one thin crossed collar with ripple embroidery; a straw-gold cape under him like a cushion; a silk cord belt with a small jade bead; bare forearms. Hands and objects: an oar across his thighs; a fishing line over the gunwale with a small cork float; a half-eaten flat cake on the thwart beside a gourd water bottle. Background: a grey-gold river, a faint far boat, afternoon haze. Light: warm golden spirit-light slanting from the upper left across his shoulders, turning his skin the colour of bronze. Expression: a slack, sun-warmed grin, careless brow, the confidence of a man who thinks it will all come out. A faint blue mote of water qi on the line, no aura.

people.imagined: Morning on the ice beside the old man. Small for his age, with the cracked fingertips of a net-mender; he sits patiently and does not shiver.
people.subject: The moment: morning on the ice beside the old man; a small boy sits cross-legged and holds his hands out in front, the edge of a huge pale straw cape just showing at the right of the frame. Face: a small, thin, earnest, brown face of about sixteen with big dark eyes, faint brows, a small nose and a small patient mouth; nose and cheeks pink with cold, his breath making no cloud. Hair: black, short, with a cowlick, under an oversized straw hat tied with blue cord. Body: small, thin, sitting very straight, knees tucked tight, barely moving. Clothing: an outer disciple's short-sleeved indigo-grey silk jacket, a little too large, over a pale under-robe with one crossed collar; a small straw-gold rain cape; a blue silk scarf tucked neatly into the collar; pale leggings bound with ribbon. Hands and objects: ten fingertips split, red-cracked and calloused, held open in the foreground, scraps of net-twine round the wrists; in his lap a half-mended net with a bone needle stuck through a mesh and a ball of twine against his thigh. Background: a white ice field, pale sky, the edge of the pale cape at the right. Light: cold pale silvery spirit-light from the upper left, each crack in his fingertips a thin red line. Expression: a patient, humble, trusting stillness, grave and untroubled by the cold. A very faint blue mote of water qi near his hands, no aura.

people.imagined: The ice in the school, a merchant's daughter who has not learned to take off her bright earrings for the ice. Her eyes slide toward the head steward's sealed pages.
people.subject: The moment: seated on the ice with her gloves off she tilts her head, letting two large earrings swing, her eyes sliding sideways toward someone's papers. Face: a pretty, sharp, pale face of about thirty with a pointed chin, clever dark eyes, thin curved brows, a small nose and a red-painted mouth in a sly little smile; a little powder pales her cheeks and a fine blush of cold shows on her nose. Hair: black, in an elaborate knot under a straw hat, with a coral comb and silver pins. Body: slender, a little too fashionable for the ice. Clothing: an inner disciple's indigo-grey robe of fine silk with three crossed collars embroidered with frozen ripples and a blue cord; a straw-gold rain cape on one shoulder; a thin gold chain at the neck; a brocade sash; fine silk gloves in her lap. Hands and objects: two large bright gold-and-coral drop earrings, long and glittering, against the dull indigo and straw; her bare hands folded, rings on two fingers, nails neat and rubbed pink; folded blank papers tucked in her sleeve. Power: a faint pale-blue shimmer of water qi on her sleeves, delicate. Background: a white ice field, a boat house, a pale sky. Light: pale cool moonlit glow from the upper left, glints off the earrings. Expression: a sly, pretty, ambitious little smile, a girl who has not learned to take off her earrings for the ice.

people.imagined: The sail-watcher's cottage. She hums in a sing-song drawl as she makes up a bed for her cousin who failed the Frost Test three times. Her thumb has a sail-cloth callus.
people.subject: The moment: in the sail-watcher's cottage she smooths a folded quilt on a bed with a cheerful sing-song hum, looking over her shoulder with a smile. Face: a round, warm, tanned face of about twenty with dimples on each side of her mouth, bright kind brown eyes, thick soft brows, a button nose, a wide easy smile and rosy cheeks. Hair: dark brown, in two loose braids tied with blue ribbon, a small silver pin. Body: stout, comfortable, strong arms, her broad hips and arms filling the space between bed and wall, standing on the balls of her feet. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a short-sleeved indigo-grey silk jacket with a crossed collar and frost-white toggles over a pale blouse; a faded blue silk kerchief; a long grey skirt; behind her on a peg a small straw-gold rain cape. Hands and objects: the right thumb thick with a long yellow-white callus ridge held out in the foreground as she smooths the quilt, which is pieced in squares of blue, grey and one red square; a clay hot-water bottle at its foot; a worn sail-cloth bag. Background: a small whitewashed cottage room, a window with grey sea. Light: warm soft glow through the window at the upper left falling on the quilt and warming the edge of her braid, dust turning slowly in the beam. Expression: eyes soft and lashes lowered a little, a gentle unhurried curve to the lips, a glance that has already made room for someone. A faint blue mote of water qi near her hands, no aura.

people.imagined: 1140, carrying the petition to the Pavilion. A memorial portrait of the loud, broad co-founder with a gap-toothed laugh and fish-scale scars on both hands, laughing even as he sits on thin spring ice.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with darkened edges and a dark vignette; a broad man laughing, seated on thin spring ice with his hands open on his knees. Face: a broad, ruddy, handsome face of about forty-five with thick black brows, bright merry crinkled dark eyes, a short flat nose, a thick black beard pointing upward as his head is thrown back, a wide laughing mouth with a gap between the front teeth; a few grey hairs at the temple. Hair: black, in a topknot held by a silver pin under a wide straw hat. Body: broad, round-shouldered, solid, leaning slightly forward, wide chest and round belly, thick corded wrists. Clothing: a founder's robes in the sect's dress: indigo-grey silk with three crossed collars and silver ripple embroidery, a straw-gold cape, a silk sash with a jade pendant, all faded softly to ghost colours. Hands and objects: both open hands covered in small pale fish-scale scars like silver scales, several overlapping on the heel of each palm, large in the foreground; a rolled blank scroll tied with blue cord sticks from his belt. Power: a faint pale-blue ghost of water qi, softened by the fade, a few motes of frost. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, a hint of a thin sheet of ice. Light: soft warm spirit-light from the upper left, the yellowed silk giving the face an amber tint, darker round the beard. Expression: the head flung back, eyes squeezed merry, the mouth wide open in a laugh he cannot hold in.
